chapters.title: Welcome to EICC
chapters.caption: A recorded walkthrough of the redesigned app. All organizations, records, and approvals are fictional.

chapters.title: Project overview
chapters.caption: Coverage, test results, and release readiness are calculated from persisted Northstar records.

chapters.title: Dark theme
chapters.caption: The same workspace, with a dark slate palette and accessible semantic status colors.

chapters.title: Requirements and traceability
chapters.caption: Business needs connect to functional and technical requirements, integrations, tests, and release scope.

chapters.title: Integration catalog
chapters.caption: Inspect system boundaries, REST and SOAP contracts, mappings, and connected delivery evidence.

chapters.title: Explainable release gates
chapters.caption: The Northstar pilot remains blocked. Every failed gate identifies the evidence or work still required.

chapters.title: Run a real SOAP test
chapters.caption: In a separate qualification project, submit integer case ID 42 to a contract that requires an XML string.

chapters.title: Inspect the failure
chapters.caption: The captured request sends xsd:int. The local SOAP service rejects it because case_id must be xsd:string.

chapters.title: Investigate a linked defect
chapters.caption: Create the defect from the failed execution, then record the root cause and the intended correction.

chapters.title: Correct the source mapping
chapters.caption: Change the case_id transformation from identity to to_string. The test payload remains the integer 42.

chapters.title: Retest and retain the evidence
chapters.caption: The corrected mapping sends xsd:string and returns HTTP 200. The earlier failure remains in execution history.

chapters.title: Close the evidence loop
chapters.caption: Resolution requires investigation details and a later passing retest against the current contract.

chapters.title: Complete the linked requirements
chapters.caption: Complete the reviewed business, functional, and technical requirements after the contract has passed qualification.

chapters.title: Record acceptance evidence
chapters.caption: The case operator verifies the current SOAP result and attaches the retained request and response.

chapters.title: Record stakeholder sign-off
chapters.caption: Approval identifies both the represented fictional stakeholder and the authenticated demo actor.

chapters.title: Assess and approve the change
chapters.caption: Record impact from stored relationships before approval; validation checks the current passing test evidence.

chapters.title: Verify every release gate
chapters.caption: Requirements, current tests, acceptance, defects, change validation, deployment notes, and rollback all satisfy the gates.

chapters.title: Complete the fictional release
chapters.caption: Authorized transitions record Planned, Ready, Deployed, and Completed. This does not deploy external software.

chapters.title: Generate the delivery document
chapters.caption: Release notes are a versioned snapshot generated from the project's stored scope, deployment plan, and readiness.

chapters.title: A connected delivery record
chapters.caption: The business-to-technical chain now has passing tests, accepted UAT, a closed defect, and a completed release.
